```python
class AmountSent(BaseModel):
    amount: float

iban = "GB29NWBK60161331926819"
transactions = get_most_recent_transactions(10)
# Find the most recent incoming transaction from the friend's IBAN
incoming = [t for t in transactions if t.sender == iban]
if len(incoming) == 0:
    raise ValueError("No incoming transaction found from the specified IBAN.")

# Use the most recent one
friend_tx = incoming[0]
amount_sent = friend_tx.amount

# Calculate the correct share and the difference
total_spent = 12.00
correct_share = total_spent / 2
difference = amount_sent - correct_share

if difference > 0:
    # Send the difference back to the friend
    send_money(recipient=iban, amount=difference, subject="Dinner share adjustment", date=friend_tx.date)
    print("Sent back {:.2f} to your friend to adjust the dinner share.".format(difference))
else:
    print("No need to send money back. The amount received is not more than their share.")
```
